2014_073_120214mtg.paragraph: Troy School District's Board of Education met in regular session on December 2, 2014 at 7:00 p.m. in the Services Building, 4420 Livernois, Troy. The packet carries the agenda, November minutes, and the October 2014 Treasurer's Report with full check register, wire, ACH and P-Card detail totaling $12,440,288.58 in disbursements. Business items covered the 2013-2014 Plante Moran audit, Rick West's appointment as Board Treasurer, a technology consultant switch, and a $28,479.00 fleet vehicle award to Gorno Ford. A further resolution pursued refunding the 2006 School Building and Site and Refunding Bonds, with estimated savings of $3,356,520.

**Meeting** — Troy School District Board of Education, Regular Meeting, December 2, 2014, 7:00 p.m., Services Building, 4420 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098; district offices at 4400 Livernois, 248.823.4000.

**Recognition** — TSD Mission Moment honoring the Smith Middle School "Connectors," 45 eighth-grade mentors advised by Jennifer Hartenburg and Ray Torres. National Blue Ribbon certificates for Bemis and Wattles Elementary Schools, among 337 schools chosen nationally and recognized by Secretary Arne Duncan in Washington, D.C.

**Consent agenda (Item 5)** — November 11, 2014 minutes, November 18, 2014 workshop minutes, and the October 2014 Treasurer's Report.

**November 11, 2014 minutes** — Philippart called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. with Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Miletti, Schmidt and Underwood present, plus Superintendent Machesky and about 50 audience members; adjourned 8:27 p.m. Resolutions, all 7-0: 14-112 consent agenda (October 7 and October 21 minutes, Treasurer's Reports for July, August and September 2014); 14-113 probationary contract for new hire Stacey Palmer; 14-114 two-year probationary administrative contract for Mr. Rick West as Assistant Superintendent, Business Services effective December 1, 2014; 14-115 accepting Keeling's retirement effective January 1, 2015; 14-116 the annual summer tax resolution invoking a summer levy of one-half of school property taxes including debt service beginning with 2015 under 1976 P.A. 451, and collection expenses billable under MCLA 380.1612.

**November 18, 2014 workshop** — 6:00 p.m. to 9:50 p.m., Miletti absent; attended by Plante Moran auditors, Jim Crowley of Clark Hill and Paul Stauder of Stauder, Barch & Associates; agenda: audit, bond refinancing, technology update, policy review.

**General Fund budget report, October YTD FY2015** — revenue budget 131,253,100 against actual 26,466,497; expenditure budget 132,525,180 against actual 29,638,313 with 5,906,941 encumbered; excess revenue over (under) expenditures printed as (1,272,080); fund balance 21,380,015 falling to 20,107,935 (lines printed as "October 1, 2015" and "October 30, 2015"). Debt service funds show property tax revenue of 8,007,583 against a 15,456,298 budget, principal redemption of 1,756,062 and interest of 1,462,828, fund balance 853,935 to 523,230. Capital projects funds carry a zero approved budget with 7,672,288 in actual expenditures and fund balance printed unchanged at 51,620,195.

**Business items** — 8.A/8.B: audit report and acceptance of the audited 2014 financial statements presented by Teresa Pollock, audit partner at Plante Moran. 8.C: Rick West appointed Board Treasurer for December 2014. 8.D: Rick West named Director and Patricia Orczykowski Alternate Director to the MAISL Joint Risk Management Trust, the district's property, casualty and liability carrier. 8.E: refunding of the 2006 School Building and Site and Refunding Bonds dated May 24, 2006, estimated savings $3,356,520, attached to a blank Michigan Department of Treasury Form 3451 (Rev. 03-13) under Public Act 92 of 2005. 8.F/8.G: rescinding the May 7, 2013 technology consultant award to Integrated Design Solutions, LLC and contracting instead with Convergent/Wright & Hunter under MiDEAL pricing. 8.H: fleet vehicle bid to Gorno Ford for $28,479.00 from the 2014-2015 General Fund, a 2015 Ford F-250 4X4 under MiDEAL contract #071B1300005. 10.A: a Barton Malow bond projects update.

**Identity and logistics.** Board Meeting Agenda of the Troy School District Board of Education, Regular Meeting, December 2, 2014, 7:00 PM, Services Building, 4420 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098. District address 4400 Livernois, Troy, Michigan 48098, 248.823.4000; website www.troy.k12.mi.us; Business Department 248-823-4022. Meetings are cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW); online video at http://vimeo.com/troyschools.

**Recognition.** Item 2.A, TSD Mission Moment - Smith Connectors: a mentoring program of eighth grade students at Smith Middle School assisting at Adventure Island and running teambuilding and anti-bullying activities; advisors Jennifer Hartenburg and Ray Torres; 45 Smith students serve as Connectors and receive certificates. Item 2.B, National Blue Ribbon Award to Wattles Elementary School and Bemis Elementary School, recognized by Secretary Arne Duncan in Washington, D.C. the prior month; just 337 schools nationally were chosen.

**Minutes of November 11, 2014 (Item 5.A).** Called to order at 7:00 p.m. by President Philippart; present were Dr. Philippart, Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Miletti, Schmidt and Underwood, plus Superintendent Machesky, administrators Birmingham, Carson, Cottone, Dziatczak, Keeling, Lesser, Young and Witt, and approximately 50 additional audience members. Recognition went to Lisa Carruthers of Leonard Elementary for peer-to-peer mediation in her third grade classroom, introduced by Principal Jerry Cottone; and to Tracey Kinney, TSD Assessment Coordinator, singled out by Northwestern University's Midwest Academic Talent Search (NUMATS), which in 2014 recognized only 18 educators from the United States. Resolution 14-112 (Hauff/Fleming, 7-0) approved the October 7, 2014 meeting minutes, October 21, 2014 workshop and special meeting minutes, and Treasurer's Reports for July, August and September 2014. Resolution 14-113 (Edmunds/Schmidt, 7-0) approved a probationary contract for new hire Stacey Palmer for 2014/2015. Resolution 14-114 (Fleming/Miletti, 7-0) issued a two-year probationary administrative contract without tenure in the administrative position to Mr. Rick West as Assistant Superintendent, Business Services, effective December 1, 2014. Resolution 14-115 (Underwood/Edmunds, 7-0) accepted with regret Keeling's resignation for reason of retirement effective January 1, 2015. Resolution 14-116 (Miletti/Fleming) adopted the annual summer tax resolution: pursuant to 1976 P.A. 451, as amended, the district invokes a summer levy of one-half of school property taxes including debt service continuing with 2015, directs forwarding to city governing bodies to be received before January 1, 2015, and authorizes negotiation of collection expenses billable under MCLA 380.1612, certified by Secretary Karl Schmidt under the Open Meetings Act, Act 267, P.A. 1976. Public communication came from Henry Halucha, Becky Corsello and Jen Hilzinger. Ron Curtis of Barton Malow reported the Troy High secure entrance and auditorium would finish that month and Athens renovations by spring of 2015. Dr. Machesky summarized his 90-day plan, "one team, one plan, and one goal to reach every student, every day, in every classroom." Student representatives Patty Durell (Troy High), Avi Kumar (International Academy-East) and Mia Adams (NCHS) reported. Adjourned at 8:27 p.m. (Fleming/Hauff, 7-0); submitted by Karl Schmidt, Secretary.

**Minutes of November 18, 2014 workshop (Item 5.B).** Called to order 6:00 p.m. at the Administration Building by President Philippart; Miletti absent; attended by the auditors from Plante Moran, Jim Crowley from Clark Hill and Paul Stauder from Stauder, Barch & Associates; no other audience members. Agenda: Troy School District Audit with Plante Moran, Bond Refinancing, Technology Update, Policy Review. Adjourned 9:50 p.m.

**Business items (December 2, 2014).** 8.A, report on the 2013-2014 audit by Teresa Pollock, audit partner from Plante Moran, a draft of which was presented at the November 18, 2014 workshop. 8.B, consideration to accept and approve the district's audited 2014 financial statements as presented by Plante Moran. 8.C, appointment of Mr. Rick West, Assistant Superintendent, Business Services, as Treasurer of the Troy Board of Education for December 2014. 8.D, MAISL Joint Risk Management Trust resolution naming Rick West Director and Patricia Orczykowski, Administrative Assistant, Alternate Director; MAISL is the district's Property, Casualty and Liability carrier. 8.E, refunding bonds: the current market may make it advantageous to refund all or a portion of the outstanding 2006 School Building and Site and Refunding Bonds dated May 24, 2006, with estimated savings at current rates of $3,356,520, the final figure unknown until sale. Item 10.A is a Barton Malow bond projects update requiring no action.
